items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: Interviewer mentions Shea in context of Jab Jones; Interviewee does not mention Shea directly or claim a personal relationship.

ctx.x: Yeah. And there's just so many of these different guys.
What about Jab Jones? I didn't know him. He's a guy who used to be around with Shea. Charlie Burst? Oh, I know him. Now he's... I think he's Kidney County. Charlie Burst there, I know him.
He's out here in East Memphis somewhere there.
